page.layout: Running head and page number at the top right; one text column on the left, with two short Greek marginal notes and one small reference mark in the right margin; signature and catchword below the column.

main_text.p: item Dialecticam tractandi iuris ratione appellaremus, abunde explicatum esse arbitramur. Reliquum est igitur, [illegible, ~12 letters]ut quam Iurisconsultorū propriam esse putemus, breuiter [illegible, ~14 letters]aperiamus. quod tamen priusquam faciamus, operæprecium esse arbitror, quorundam obiectionibus obuiam ire, qui nostram hanc Analysin propterea damnare possent, quòd interdum audiant nihil esse perniciosius, quàm Ius ciuile ad thefes & uniuersales quasdam regulas reuocare. Fuerunt enim adolescentes nō pauci, qui meum hoc institutum in publicis meis in-

page.notes: Two Greek marginal notes in the right margin (beside "Reliquum est igitur" and "breuiter") are only partly legible; the letters are not certain, so they are marked illegible. A small reference mark appears at "quod tamen" in the right margin and is not transcribed. The text "thefes" is printed as such and kept. The catchword "in-" and signature "f 3" are at the foot of the text column.
